en: A black-and-white photograph depicting a formal garden or park with a circular pond or fountain in the foreground, surrounded by lush trees. In the background, across the open green space, stands a long, historic building with ornate architectural elements and a central tower-like feature. The scene is tranquil, with only a few visible people, and the overall style hints at early 20th-century Europe.
